Exactly 1 × a clear stemmed glass half-filled with dark red wine; 1 × a small matte black bowl filled with white flake salt; 1 × a rectangular black slate board. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: Low three-quarter view rotated 55 degrees to the left, keeping all dishes in the lower half without overlap, 85 mm lens at f/2.8, Slate board with sliced beef angled diagonally in lower left, white plate of ham behind-center, hand with wine glass on lower right, leaving clean deep-black space across the upper 40% for typography. Single neutral 5000 K hard side-back light from the left rimming the glass, meat crust and ham fat, background falling 2 stops into near black, Near-black monochrome with neutral whites on the plate and deep crimson red in the wine, ham and beef centre as the only strong colour. Overall aesthetic: low-key light, a single hard side light or flash, deep shadows; a dark, almost black environment; no props beyond the real tableware; rich but controlled colours, the dish the only bright area; the dish in three-quarter view in the lower part, dark air above for the title. Iluminación de estudio de producto: un solo foco neutro de unos 5000 K, lateral y ligeramente por detrás, dibuja el contorno. El alimento es lo más luminoso y el fondo cae entre 1,5 y 2 pasos, sin relleno sobre el fondo. Negros con profundidad y reflejos controlados, sin quemar. Balance de blancos neutro. La loza blanca y el lino claro conservan su tono neutro, incluso si la escena tiene materiales de color. Los dorados pertenecen a la cocción y a la corteza, los rojos o marrones a los materiales que los tienen. Corrige una dominante amarilla, ámbar o naranja que tiña toda la imagen, incluso si aparece en una foto de referencia. Photographic realism, no text. Editorial direction: Keep the upper part quiet for a large masthead. Let the top edge of the dish reach the lower edge of that space. Keep a coherent light direction and preserve the texture of the dish. Render no lettering or graphics.
